result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel cards are vertically misaligned: image heights and badge positions differ per card, causing restaurant names and delivery fees to sit at inconsistent baselines (Green Bowl Poké's title starts higher than Smash Bros Burgers', which starts higher than Trattoria Piccola's). Other elements (header, promo banner, popular list, bottom nav) render correctly.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the cards are not vertically aligned: the Green Bowl Poké card's image is taller and its time badge sits lower, so its title and delivery fee appear at a different vertical position than Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria Piccola, producing a ragged, misaligned row.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a fixed image height and align items to a common top baseline (e.g., align-items: flex-start with uniform card structure), so titles, badges, and prices line up across cards.

issues.description: The delivery-time badge placement is inconsistent across carousel cards: on Green Bowl Poké it overlays the bottom-left of the image, on Smash Bros Burgers it overlaps the bottom edge of the image, and on Trattoria Piccola it sits near the vertical middle-left, making the pattern look unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the badge to a single anchored position (e.g., bottom-left with consistent offset) on every card image.
